latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Employee Training Program Builder.
- Generates detailed curricula, schedules, assessment criteria, and completion tracking for any role or compliance need.
- Supports onboarding, compliance training, upskilling, leadership development, and certification prep.
- Includes templates for program structure, assessment frameworks, completion tracking tables, and ROI metrics.
- Provides instructions, tips for effective training programs, and links to industry context packs and useful calculators.
